codeReview.summary: The feature improves heartbeat/progress reporting and demonstrates two successful smoke runs, but it does not fully harden startup reliability for browser flow validators. The commit’s own browser smoke artifact still records a startup failure that required a manual CDP workaround outside the new flow-validator instructions, so the expected ‘consistent completion without parent fallback’ behavior is not fully met.

issues.description: Startup hardening is incomplete for browser validators. The new timeout guidance adds heartbeat/retry behavior but does not codify a deterministic browser bootstrap path for known launcher/runtime-linker failures. The same commit’s browser report shows startup failed due missing libnspr4 and required an ad-hoc CDP workaround (see browser-timeout-hardening-smoke.json:70-71), which means routine browser groups still are not reliably self-sufficient under normal load.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature is metadata-assigned to fullstack-worker, but the work is validation/droid hardening (no backend+frontend feature implementation). This causes predictable procedure drift versus SKILL.md (tests-first backend/frontend workflow) and adds noise in execution expectations.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Feature entry sets skillName=fullstack-worker; transcript skeleton shows fullstack-worker invocation, while commit 8bd215c changes only .factory/droids/user-testing-flow-validator.md and validation flow artifacts.

summary: Reviewed feature misc-validation-flow-validator-timeout-hardening (commit 8bd215c) using feature metadata, handoff, transcript skeleton, skill guidance, and full diff. The change improves heartbeat/retry behavior but fails the startup-reliability objective because browser flow startup still required manual fallback not codified in the new flow-validator instructions.
